spine.active_goal: Find why the Meadow page loads and changes time of day slowly on Windows (and freezes after several time changes plus a full-screen toggle), why it loads slowly on Android, and why the onboarding Meadow animation is slow and choppy on every platform; fix each cause without changing how either looks (quality included), test on the owner's Windows PC with a heavily seeded journal, and ship through the pipeline as draft PRs.
spine.next_step: Invoke Skill interphase:bug with the Meadow pacing fix request (cap of 4 snapshot renders per frame gap counted in meadow_pacer.dart, after-batch readback marker, builds fill the cap, frame-free first build in meadow_stage.dart _scheduleStep/_step/_sendBuild, split multi-snapshot units in meadow_layers.dart, paced rays recolour in meadow_rays.dart) ending "Work autonomously.", then build it with mitosis from ~/.mitosis/field-notes/U+003Cslug>/.
spine.last_session: Investigated on the Windows PC (seeded profile builds over the VM service), the Android emulator and the macOS VM. Root cause: more than 4 snapshot renders between frames evict Impeller's per-frame render targets; ANGLE frees them late and runs out of video memory. Lab A/B chose the pacing design in decision 01M4T8H3J1EKGDZYMWMV8H2HCB. Kit and results at ~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-perf/kit. Separate Windows abort in the notifications plugin's cancel spun off as a task.

key_decisions.title: Meadow pacing fix: cap snapshot renders per frame gap, honest after-batch readback marker, builds fill the cap, frame-free first build
